title: The Church is One Big Cosplay—And No One Wants to Admit It

top_liked.author: @Lloyd_2001
top_liked.text: I hate when people say: "God put this on my hearth to tell you this" Nahh he didn't tell you shit.

top_liked.author: @JamesRichardWiley
top_liked.text: The expensive robes, the secret words, the symbolic gestures all designed to create mystery and wonder.

Amen my brother

top_liked.author: @kc7476
top_liked.text: "People pretend to have faith because the cost of doubt is too high". Perfectly said. I think this is the subconscious reason why rational people hold on to faith. Consciously, it doesn't feel like pretending, it feels like they're making the right decision.
